runtime_notes.preferred_playback: Decoded Web Audio buffers for short SFX; HTMLAudio pool only as fallback.
runtime_notes.generation_policy: Prefer local synthesis for short game-feel/UI sounds. Use sourced online sounds only when synthesis is insufficient; record source URL, license, attribution, transformation, and fair-use rationale before wiring.
runtime_notes.mix_goals: SFX must read over persistent music at MUSIC_VOLUME 0.58. Pickup sounds should be <180ms. Impacts may be louder but should avoid masking repeated chain hits.
runtime_notes.implementation_state: Generated SFX set is wired in src/main.js for UI, pickups, complement loop/ingest, ram, chain knockback, wall kill, death/respawn, fever warning, vacuum start, nest cleanse, and level clear.

sfx.event: Menu button accepted: New Run, Tutorial, Resume, Replay, Continue, Dismiss, Advance.
sfx.generation_plan: Local synthesis: 70-90ms rounded click, low sine blip around 420Hz, tiny filtered noise transient, fast decay.
sfx.notes: Should not sound like eating; it is UI confirmation only.
sfx.license: Project-owned local synthesis; no external samples used.

sfx.generation_plan: Local synthesis: 100ms two-part click, down-up pitch pair. Use reversed pitch direction for disable/off variant if needed.
sfx.notes: Optional; avoid fatigue because pause/music buttons may be tapped repeatedly.
sfx.license: Project-owned local synthesis; no external samples used.

sfx.event: Antibody collected directly or by vacuum visual touch.
sfx.generation_plan: Local synthesis via tools/sfx_synth.py preset eat_antibody.
sfx.notes: Already converted to low-latency Web Audio buffer path. Keep short and immediately audible.
sfx.license: Project-owned local synthesis; no external samples used.

sfx.event: Complement pellet picked up or vacuum-collected.
sfx.generation_plan: Local synthesis: 220-320ms rising wet shimmer, low pulse plus bright harmonic sweep, slight stereo-safe chorus if using Web Audio buffer only mono/stereo optional.
sfx.notes: Should clearly distinguish complement from antibody. Trigger once per complement activation.
sfx.license: Project-owned local synthesis; no external samples used.

sfx.event: Complement active while player can ingest enemies.
sfx.generation_plan: Local synthesis: seamless 1.2s loop, two alternating muted siren tones around 540/720Hz, pulsing wet filtered noise bed, low volume under music. Needs zero-cross or equal-power loop seam.
sfx.notes: Implement as a separate loop source with gain fade in/out, not repeated one-shots. Must stop/pause with global audio pause/background handling.
sfx.license: Project-owned local synthesis; no external samples used.

sfx.generation_plan: Local synthesis plus optional sourced wet gulp layer if needed. 180-260ms downward formant gulp, brief fizz tail.
hook_points: updateEnemies complement suction branch before killEnemy(enemy)
sfx.notes: Different from wall/chain death. Power-state reward sound.
sfx.license: Project-owned local synthesis; no external samples used.

sfx.generation_plan: Local synthesis: 90-140ms rubbery pitch drop plus compressed thump, immediate transient.
sfx.notes: Should play even if no enemy is hit, because it confirms dash input.
sfx.license: Project-owned local synthesis; no external samples used.

sfx.event: Ram contact launches an enemy into knockback.
sfx.generation_plan: Local synthesis: 120-170ms slap/thump with upward whoosh edge. Avoid final crunch, because death happens on wall/enemy impact.
hook_points: launchEnemyKnockback when source is player ram
sfx.notes: May need source/reason parameter so chain launches can use chain variation.
sfx.license: Project-owned local synthesis; no external samples used.

sfx.event: Knocked enemy hits another enemy and launches it onward.
sfx.generation_plan: Local synthesis: 90-130ms compact slap/crack with pitch randomized in runtime by playbackRate if supported. Needs to tolerate rapid repeats.
hook_points: updateEnemyKnockback hitEnemy branch before launchEnemyKnockback(hitEnemy, dir, chainDistance)
sfx.notes: Use for repeated chain knockbacks. Consider alternating 2-3 variants if chain feels machine-gun.
sfx.license: Project-owned local synthesis; no external samples used.

sfx.event: Knocked enemy hits wall and dies.
sfx.generation_plan: Local synthesis with optional sourced splat layer later. 180-280ms wet impact, low thud plus noisy membrane burst.
sfx.notes: This is the final kill confirmation for ram wall impacts.
sfx.license: Project-owned local synthesis; no external samples used.

sfx.event: Enemy death animation starts for any non-complement kill if no more specific sound already played.
sfx.generation_plan: Local synthesis: 300-450ms soft rupturing fizz with descending tone, lower priority than wall/chain/complement sounds.
sfx.notes: Use carefully to avoid double-stacking with wall kill or complement ingest. Could be fallback only.
sfx.license: Project-owned local synthesis; no external samples used.

sfx.generation_plan: Local synthesis plus optional sourced tear layer. 450-700ms sting, high transient then low failing pulse.
sfx.notes: Should cut through music. Do not stop music; it plays over the result state.
sfx.license: Project-owned local synthesis; no external samples used.

sfx.event: All antibodies collected; infection nest neutralized cleanse wave begins.
sfx.generation_plan: Local synthesis: 1.2-1.8s rising wash, low heartbeat resolves into bright harmonic bloom. Optional generated/source layer later for organic breadth.
sfx.notes: This should pair with the visual neutralization effect, not just level exit.
sfx.license: Project-owned local synthesis; no external samples used.

sfx.event: Player enters lymph gate after collecting all antibodies.
sfx.generation_plan: Local synthesis: 700-1000ms warm success swell, membrane portal shimmer, no arcade jingle cheese.
hook_points: collectCurrentTile tile === 'G' branch when state.won = true
sfx.notes: Distinct from nest cleanse; this confirms actual level exit.
sfx.license: Project-owned local synthesis; no external samples used.

sfx.generation_plan: Local synthesis: 220ms bubbling warning pulse, low volume, spatial/positional later if engine supports.
hook_points: finishEnemyDeath setting respawning could optionally schedule pre-warning
sfx.notes: Helps sell the ghost-cage infection nest.
sfx.license: Project-owned local synthesis; no external samples used.

sfx.event: Fever high or enemy very close.
sfx.generation_plan: Local synthesis: periodic low pulse that rate-scales with fever. Consider procedural Web Audio instead of asset file.
sfx.notes: Do not add until mix has room; complement siren is higher priority.
sfx.license: Project-owned local synthesis; no external samples used.

sfx.event: Antibody begins vacuum pull toward player.
sfx.generation_plan: Local synthesis: 45ms quiet suction blip. Use rate limit so chains of pickups do not chatter.
sfx.notes: Might be unnecessary now that eat_antibody triggers earlier.
sfx.license: Project-owned local synthesis; no external samples used.
